source: Supplied seven complete CS papers, 2023–2026; final keys and original question images retained.
methodology: Primary topic only receives marks; secondary mappings are learning links. For each year, marks are averaged across its papers, then the four annual means are averaged including zeros. VVI means at least four primary questions across at least three distinct years. High means at least two years or at least one year-balanced mean mark. These describe this sample, not a 2027 prediction; all syllabus topics remain required.
